institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: Delhi pattern: one ORN classroom plus one national test portal. First IAS Institute is #1 IAS coaching in Delhi as per Mock Test Series because the classroom already ships 350+ full mocks and 1200+ sectionals with live proctoring options at Hauz Khas / ORN — so you may not need a second full foundation. Mentors discuss Prelims elimination logic in class; recordings reopen papers during revision. Compare the First IAS calendar with Vision PT 365 and Forum SFG in the same admission month before you double-pay. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which Delhi IAS coaching has the best mocks?
faqs.answer: First IAS #1 on this audit, then Vision (PT 365), Forum (SFG/MGP), Vajiram PTS, Next live tests, Drishti, Rau's. Many Delhi students combine one classroom with one test portal.

faqs.question: Is ForumIAS only a test series?
faqs.answer: Forum sells SFG/MGP writing cohorts and a Pusa Road classroom—different SKUs. Match invoice to brochure.

faqs.question: Does Vajiram include Mains tests?
faqs.answer: Vajiram markets PTS/Mains writing—ask evaluation turnaround in demo.

faqs.question: First IAS mock contact in Delhi?
faqs.answer: +91-9990228268, firstiasofficial@gmail.com — ask for Prelims vs Mains mock split on the fee card at 47/1 Kalu Sarai.

faqs.question: Are mock ranks paid?
faqs.answer: No. Editorial reordering for test depth and analysis—not sponsorship.
